authors_reviews.title: Amazing little headlamp
authors_reviews.text: I'm not any expert on headlamps like this, but I will say is for the short time I have had this and why I got it, its exceeds my expectations. I got this for working under a vehicle, in the attic of other places where you need both hands and direct light. The hat clip holds really well but the head band is comfortable enough if it isn't too tight. I also found that if you leave the hat clip on the light and slip the head band into it, you wouldn't lose the clip somewhere. It lights up bright enough for my purposes and stays bright for more than the time the instructions state, so far. I tested the Turbo light and used a stopwatch to see how long it could hold that level, and even after using it for a short time before testing the Turbo level, it held that level of brightness longer than the stated 30 seconds. I was expecting the light to just shut off after the turbo level, but I was surprised the light level just dropped to High. Which would be good so you don't just lose all light at once. You just push the button repeatedly and select the level you need, and to switch to Turbo, just hold the button after you are at the level you were at. It doesn't come with a charger, but most everyone has more USB chargers than you need. It includes a USB-C cable which is now the most common anyway. Overall I can see keeping this handy. It also states that if you register it, it has a limited lifetime warranty.
authors_reviews.author: Cubeman

authors_reviews.title: A Compact and Versatile Lighting Solution
authors_reviews.text: The Nebo Mycro 450 rechargeable headlamp is an impressive and thoughtfully designed product that offers a robust lighting solution for a variety of situations. With a maximum output of 450 lumens, this headlamp provides more than enough brightness for work projects or outdoor use, or in an emergency situation• With six light modes you can choose between Turbo, High, Medium, Low, Red, and Green to tailor the light output to your needs.• This headlamp is built from aircraft-grade aluminum; so it is both lightweight and tough, with water resistance that makes it suitable for various weather conditions• The included USB-A to USB-C charging cable allows for easy recharging and the battery charging indicator keeps you informed, though it’s important to note that the package does not include a charging block, and there are no instructions regarding recommended charging volts or amps. For specific charging questions, you can reach out to NEBO at www.nebolights.com.• This headlamp quickly converts to a cap light, making it even more adaptable. The included clip easily attaches to a cap visor, and the adjustable headband ensures a comfortable fit.The build quality is excellent, true to what I’ve come to expect from NEBO products. This isn’t my first NEBO light, and, once again, I’m highly satisfied. The headlamp feels sturdy without being heavy, and its water resistance ensures reliability when used outdoors. It would be helpful if Nebo included a charging block and provided clear instructions regarding recommended charging voltage and amperage. This would prevent any confusion and ensure safe charging practices. That being said, based on my experience with Nebo products, I highly recommend this brand if you are in the market for a quality lighting product

authors_reviews.title: Bright, Lightweight and Rechargeable
authors_reviews.text: This headset features a really bright and rechargeable light. It is easy and quick to charge the battery with the included USB-C charging cable, and battery life is good for hours, depending upon which brightness setting is used. The control system is a bit confusing, as it requires repeated presses of the on/off button, and the instructions are far from clear. I like that the light is lightweight and the head strap is easy to adjust to your head size. It is reasonably comfortable to wear, due to its light weight. I did not like the blister packaging, as it was a pain to cut away the clear plastic without damaging the rather fragile plastic hinge that controls the angle of the beam. I gave it 5 stars, but if they changed the packaging and improved the instructions, I would have awarded 6 stars if such a thing were allowed.
